sources.authority: Ministry of Railways / Railway Board (published by IRICEN, Pune)
sources.title: Indian Railways Bridge Manual
sources.edition: 2024, incorporating advance correction slips up to ACS-45
sources.scope: Investigation, hydraulics, foundations, substructure, protection and maintenance practice. The manual itself states that the IRS codes override it for design and construction where they conflict.
sources.notes: The only Tier-1 document in hand whose text was read with page numbers. Every rule promoted to NORMATIVE cites a paragraph indexed in knowledge/extracted/irbm-2024.json.

sources.title: RDSO Guidelines on Seismic Design of Railway Bridges
sources.scope: Seismic analysis, seating widths, bearings and restrainers of railway bridges.
sources.notes: Read in hand (cl. 4.4 box and pipe culverts need no seismic analysis; cl. 14.3 seating width). A secondary source says the IRS Seismic Code 2020 supersedes it; that code is not in hand, so edition-dependent values stay DISPUTED (KC-8, KC-9, KC-17).

sources.title: IRS Seismic Code — Criteria for Earthquake Resistant Design of Railway Bridges
sources.notes: Not in hand. Values quoted by SRC-CLAUDE-RESEARCH only.

sources.title: IRS Code of Practice for the Design of Sub-structures and Foundations of Bridges
sources.edition: 2nd revision 2013 (correction slips up to 29); the secondary source read the 2003 text
sources.notes: Not in hand. Clauses quoted by SRC-CLAUDE-RESEARCH only.

sources.title: Indian Railways Construction Manual
sources.notes: Not in hand. Box-culvert policy quoted from search snippets by SRC-CLAUDE-RESEARCH.

sources.title: Guidelines for Planning of Road Over Bridges
RDSO standard drawings for RCC box culverts, slabs and girders (B-10152/10155, B-10158/10154, M-00004/5, BA-10063 …)
sources.notes: Drawing numbers known from lists only; no sheet in hand. No dimension from them is executable (KC-18).
